normal_signature: Single, isolated, contiguous white region against a pure black background
Granular, stippled texture filling the interior of the shape
Organic, irregular, and smooth boundary contours
Absence of internal voids or holes within the white mass
No external artifacts, noise, or secondary objects in the frame
hypothesized_anomaly_modes: Structural fragmentation: The object breaks into multiple disconnected components or islands.
Internal cavitation: The presence of black holes or voids within the white region, indicating missing material.
Surface erosion: The texture becomes sparse, patchy, or non-uniform, deviating from the dense stippled pattern.
Geometric deformation: The object exhibits unnatural sharp angles, straight lines, or extreme elongation inconsistent with the organic class shape.
Contamination: Appearance of foreign objects or noise clusters in the black background area.
rules: if the white region consists of multiple disconnected components then lean anomaly
if there are black holes or voids inside the white region then lean anomaly
if the texture is sparse, patchy, or significantly non-uniform then lean anomaly
if the object has sharp geometric edges or straight lines then lean anomaly
if there are any white pixels in the black background area then lean anomaly
if the object is a single contiguous mass with uniform granular texture then lean normal
